title: Back with Papa Celestin; saxophonists and Lorenzo Tio
summary: Bill returns to New Orleans, joins Celestin, and discusses pianists and the Tios.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

I played with Sidney a little while, but Sidney was a funny fellow with that stuff, you know. Yeah, I've heard that. That money. Yeah, I've heard that. The old Roche, we call him Roche. So me and little McCollum, George McCollum, nice little trumpet player, made up a good bunch of fellas and started playing around here.
